title: Torsion-free modules over a Dedekind domain are flat
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian integrally closed commutative domain of Krull dimension at most one, and let $N$ be any $A$-module. Suppose $N$ is torsion-free, meaning that $an=0$ with $0\ne a\in A$ implies $n=0$. Then $N$ is flat over $A$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. No finite generation hypothesis on $N$ is imposed.
